name: DeKalb Cubing Fall 2023
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DeKalbCubingFall2023#17574-competitor-responsibilities) tab. You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Wisconsin and Illinois Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473). This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcXhLIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7a00bd87ea2d3c10357956e133ce96ffc7e73a4b/image.png)
